title: Where can recovered heat from a mesh-belt normalising and tempering line be used?
summary: Suneng's 2017 mesh-belt normalising and tempering line proposal links post-normalising workpiece cooling to inlet hot-air preheating and a water-cooled cooling hood. Hot cooling air returns to the inlet preheating chamber; water in the hood absorbs radiant heat. The air path has a defined heat user, while the water is only described as available for other uses. Check the two circuits separately rather than counting both as realised energy savings.
